name: Yamashiro

sources.title: Wikipedia — Japanese battleship Yamashiro (sunk in the Battle of Surigao Strait, 25 October 1944)
Wikipedia — RV Petrel (found Yamashiro and Fusō in 2017)
Divernet — Deep historic war wrecks located in the Philippines (both battleships inverted at about 200 m)
The Manila Shimbun — Wreck of Japanese battleship Yamashiro found

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q598221_yamashiro.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upside down at about 180-200 m in the Surigao Strait: the bulged hull keel up, the turrets and the pagoda bridge crushed under her, the torpedo holes, the top of the pagoda broken off on the bottom beside her. A war grave (some 1,600 died). The damage, the broken-off pieces and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the battleship as she was in 1944. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
